purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for a Sa'ueia breeding-ground caretaker handover during eclipse ingress.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through anchors for the open arrival terrace, ordinary handover work, a burden-flower alarm, quarantine geometry, witness choices, totality threshold, and four ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate anchors for the terrace establishing frame, participant introduction, routine work hub, routine fold, flower alarm, quarantine action hub, multi-witness fold, route-choice hub, totality threshold, and every ending family. The burden-flower bloom stands alone as the pivotal interruption.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Every base prompt restates visible geometry, light, materials, bodies, tools, and placements for a general image model. Character refs are assembled only for named characters visible in that frame. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Painterly speculative-ecology storybook frame, restrained gouache and ink texture, low-energy bioluminescence, readable alien anatomy, precise ecological infrastructure, deep eclipse blues against muted amber and mineral earth, humane workplace detail, cinematic interactive-fiction composition.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble the global_style_cue, each scene base_image_prompt, visual refs for named visible characters, and triggered state or global branch modifiers. Each text-only render receives the complete visible room geometry. Continuity notes are excluded from assembled prompts.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The story revisits one terrace from several angles and makes sightlines, ramps, boundary arcs, object placement, and branch-created routes mechanically important. Textual prompts support concept frames but are not geometry authority.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before replay-ready website rendering, build a plan view or 3D blockout with the fan-shaped terrace, fungal boundary crossing its narrow throat, boundary-straddling work cradle, nurseryward ramps, inner lantern-tree rim, outer isolation shelter, fixed camera slots, and branch-visible clean or closed lanes.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide elevated establishing view of an outdoor alien nursery arrival terrace at eclipse ingress. A fan-shaped platform of dark root-bound stone narrows toward a living road marked by two rows of faint amber fungal beads; their visible boundary arcs across the fan's narrow throat, where a pale flexible-rib work cradle straddles the line with one rail on each side. The fan broadens toward three shallow ramps descending into warm communal nursery hollows. Tall lantern trees line the inner rim with cold blue luminous knots hanging under their canopies. A low crescent isolation shelter of grown ribs and translucent leaf-skin curves beyond the outer rim. An enormous fixed dark planet begins covering a dim red-orange sun. Small long-bodied six-limbed caretakers move around the low terrace.

visible_characters.default_stance: small figures folded at low work surfaces and moving between nursery ramps

visual_continuity_notes: The terrace is a fan: fungal road at the narrow routeward point, three nursery ramps along the broad nurseryward edge, lantern grove on the inner rim, isolation shelter beyond the outer rim, and work cradle in the center.
Umbros remains fixed above the lantern-grove side of the terrace throughout the fixture.

global_branch_image_modifiers.modifier_prompt: Seyr places one clean failed pale graft strip between the amber fungal candles; a fresh candle opens beside it.
Seyr and Nara fold on opposite sides of the low cradle, chest hands inspecting colored graft seams and small braided oath knots.

Nara folds inside the bitter ring, exposes a darkened bare throat patch, and opens graft trays with two small chest hands; one tray shows a faint violet seam.

Mottled Echo grips Nara's bare left flank patch with clasping rootlets and displays its current color pattern against her dark hide.
Thin mycelial threads draw a shed body fiber, one damp foot-pressure trace, and cradle residue into the road's amber boundary.
Seyr fans the archive membranes across the cradle; one old violet route edge aligns visibly with the suspect graft seam.
One medical graft tray is sealed in translucent leaf-skin and placed alone on the cradle's outer rail toward the isolation shelter.
A continuous cold blue-white line of low lantern knots traces the terrace's outer curve to the crescent isolation shelter while nursery ramps stay dark.
A threadwing grips a tiny clean knotted-fiber packet in its mouthparts, silver ribbon vanes spread for routeward flight.
Nara walks beside Seyr through a narrow healthy amber lane while the suspect graft tray remains sealed on the outer cradle rail and Ili receives the archive.
Every fungal candle under Seyr's feet goes dark, lantern knots close in sequence, Ili blocks the first ramp, and Nara remains outside the boundary.
The outer lane is continuous and firm; Seyr and Nara settle around the isolation shelter's floor cradle with clean grafts inward and the suspect tray outward.
The amber lane stops halfway, soft ground sinks beneath Nara's front foot, and a fallen clean tray splits its pale leaf-skin seam on dark stone.
Nara rests safely on a low routeward cradle with mineral cloths while Seyr remains alert beside the closed archive through returning light.
Nara's long body trembles between both locomotor leg pairs, Mottled Echo displays hard yellow fatigue, and waiting graft trays remain visible by the dark nursery ramp.
The returning threadwing lands on the archive with a fiber sample, the fungal road opens amber candles toward isolation, and the lantern grove answers blue-white.
The sky brightens with returning light, route travelers gather behind exhausted Nara, the threadwing remains absent, and Mottled Echo repeats a harsh red-violet display.
